versions.content: Provide memory mapping header file names As a default rule, there is one memory mapping header file per BSW module or per SWC and the name of this file includes the shortName of the BswModuleDescription resp. the AtomicSwComponentType as a prefix. However, for BSW modules or clusters it is possible to supersede the default rule by explicit reference to one or more files with specific names and granularity. This is specified by defining one or more DependencyOnArtifact elements aggregated by 137 of 334  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 89: AUTOSAR_TPS_BSWModuleDescriptionTemplate Basic Software Module Description Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 BswImplementation in the role requiredArtifact and with DependencyOnAr- tifact . category set to the value MEMMAP . The detailed rules on how these header file names are derived are given in [19]: [SWS_MemMap_00028], [SWS_MemMap_00029], [SWS_MemMap_00032], [SWS_- MemMap_00035]
